correctness.rationale: Complete enumeration of all dihedral orbits of nonempty-face flags for \(3\le n\le13\), with no inversions. Every elementary reduction uses a codimension-one free cell and its sole remaining coface, in descending dimension. Nine quotients collapse completely. At \(n=11\) and \(n=13\) the final signed integer chain ranks are (8,27,25) and (13,51,49); all nonzero Smith factors equal one; all consecutive boundary compositions vanish. These give integral homology of \(S^3\) without hidden torsion. Independently computed fixed-point Euler characteristics agree. Original complexes are simply connected at these two n by the cycle independence recurrence, reflections have fixed points and generate D_n, and Armstrong plus Hurewicz plus homological Whitehead upgrades the homology to the asserted homotopy types. Exact standalone source and output are embedded.

value.rationale: The eleven widths comprise exactly the first range in which every cycle independence complex has reduced homology in dimension at most three, ending immediately before dimension-four homology appears at width fourteen. Finding two and only two noncontractible geometric full-dihedral quotients (both \(S^3\)) provides an exact finite topological transition not determined by cyclic-rotation calculations or rational traces. The outcome determines the integral groups, simple connectivity and full homotopy types, not a routine numerical invariant.
